name: Watcher
description: a floating eye of the Rune Bridges: a big round pale grey stone eyeball with a single glowing cyan iris and pupil, a heavy carved stone eyelid, a ring of small floating rune stones orbiting it, a faint cyan glow

poses.stand: floating in the air, the stone lid open, the cyan eye staring to the right
poses.struck: the stone lid slammed shut, cracked
poses.dead: cracking apart into stone pieces and fading cyan dust
poses.shut: the same eye with its heavy carved stone eyelid closed over it, only a thin cyan line of light showing

idle.action: floats with its heavy stone eyelid shut, bobbing, the rune stones orbiting slowly

attack.action: stares wide open, the cyan iris flaring bright again and again as bolts of cyan light shoot out of the pupil to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
